nom: Ahava Hyaluronic Acid Leave On Mask

avis.texte: Consegna nei tempi indicati. Acquistato perché ho sentito parlare di questa marca ed ero curiosa di provarla. Io ho una pelle secca e l'ho provata come indicato sulla confezione. Ho applicato uno strato su tutto il viso come fosse una maschera, l'ho lasciata agire per 10 minuti poi il poco rimasto (la mia belle se ne è bevuta parecchia) l'ho massaggiato fino a completo assorbimento. Ho visto la mia pelle distesa, le piccole rughe scomparse ed il viso più rimpolpato. Sicuramente proverò altri prodotti di questa linea.

Ahava is know to be a pretty luxurious brand, their skincare is usually infused with Dead Sea minerals. I’m not sure if mask is an accurate name for this product, I feel like it’s more a cream that’s very effective. The mask comes in a glass 100 ml jar. You are supposed to apply a layer of it onto the skin for 10 minutes and then massage the remaining cream onto the skin. This is where the confusion with what this product really is lays. It’s advised to use the product 1 to 2 rimes a week. The consistency is like a creamy gel, the product has a very faint scent to it. The current price at the time of writing this review is £39.80. This product is very good. It’s very easy to use, no rinsing required, hence you can just pop it on onto your clean skin and just leave it. The skin is instantly plump, smoother and very moisturised. After regular usage over one month I did notice that my skin looks very fresh and even as well, it must be the minerals that the product is infused with. Overall, it’s a yes for me. The product may be a little bit pricey but it is definitely worth it. So easy to use and provides visible results from the start. Highly recommended 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Fantastic! If you are looking for a product to hydrate and nourish the skin, look no further. This is a fantastic product that has worked so well on my sensitive skin. I struggle to find products that actually help my skin without causing irritation so I am so happy to have found something that works. Truly obsessed. I have normal skin but very dehydrated skin and this product give my skin the moisture it desperately needs. I’ve got plenty of moisturising masks but I was looking for something that will plump my skin and make my skin bouncy. And this mask basically does that!!! I have already used it 3 times and I love it! As soon as you apply this, you can feel it working some kind of magic and it does make you feel good. Overall, I can't fault the product and would happily recommend it, especially if you're looking to treat yourself and want a mask that undoubtedly nourishes your skin.

This is an overnight mask that leaves your skin feeling moisturised without any stickiness. Leave on for 10 minutes and then massage into the skin and leave overnight. Left my partner's skin softer and smoother after a few applications, so all good!

I like the idea of leave-on masks as sometimes you seem to load your skin with goodness and then wipe most of it off, this with a leave-on mask I think you can maximize the benefits of the product. This product is the AHAVA Hyaluronic Acid Leave-On Mask which as well as the anti-aging superstar ingredient of Hyaluronic Acid also contains Aloe Vera and Dead Sea Minerals. It is designed to renew and rejuvenate your skin, to enhance suppleness, provide hydration, reduce puffiness and visible lines and to leave a more even complexion. The mask comes in a glass jar and is very simple to use. All I do is apply my face after cleansing and then leave it on for about ten minutes and then massage in any residue of the cream. It has a nice creamy texture which actually feels quite cooling. I first used some on a really hot day and it felt lovely on my overheated skin. As long as you have your hair out of the way it’s quite easy to put the mask on and then forget about it for ten minutes whilst it does its stuff. I know I should be sitting back and relaxing during this time but I tend to end up doing all sorts of things from cleaning out the bath to loading the dishwasher! After the ten minutes I would say that although my skin feels soft I wouldn’t say it was amazingly so. At first I wondered if I was using too much product as it seemed to sit on the top of my skin even after massaging it in but I think it’s just not absorbing it quite how I would like it to.
